about: The inputs of the Windows worker proof (FU-CI-WINDOWS-INPUT-GATE, owner ruling D-279). A PR or merge group that changes a path matching any pattern here runs the full proof; one that changes none skips it, naming the diff it checked. Patterns are globs matched without regard to case (** any depth, * within one name, {a,b} alternatives). Derived from what the suites and the negative controls read: scripts/ci/worker-proof-inputs.spec.mjs fails when a suite source names a tracked path not covered here. Paths a Windows checkout cannot reproduce exactly are a further run condition, in scripts/ci/worker-proof-inputs.mjs.
